name: navigator-branch-grant-reconciled
body: The navigator's main-git guard requirement names its git grant set: `git status *`, `git diff *`, `git log *`, `git branch --show-current`, `git worktree list *`, and a worktree-bounded `git rebase *`. Branch-ref rewrites (`git branch -f`, `git branch -D`, `git branch -m`), `git merge`, `git checkout`, and `git switch` sit outside the grant set. The blanket `git branch *` pattern grants branch-ref rewrites that bypass the verify gate, so the exact read-only pattern `git branch --show-current` carries the grant instead; branch listing is dropped because the branch/worktree identity arrives from `apg project start`'s printed path and `git status`. `requirements.constraint.main-integration-via-merge-gate-only` and `solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt` state the same grant set. `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md` lines 38-39 grant the blanket `git branch *` plus `git remote *`, and `requirements.requirement.agent-builder-main-flow`, `requirements.constraint.agent-changes-always-on-main`, and `solution.component.agent-builder-prompt` name those as the read-only git patterns.
